prompts.panjeeri: Use case: product-mockup. Create one production homepage HERO BACKGROUND PHOTOGRAPH, landscape 1536x1024, not an app screenshot. Image 1 is the user's exact design reference: match ONLY the hero's warm cream photographic background, bright natural sunlight, softly blurred green leaves, rustic wooden bowl and premium food styling. Image 2 supplies actual Nourish Spoon packaging/brand. The photo must fill the whole frame with continuous natural cream interior/tabletop, soft leaf shadows, and real depth; no flat blank color block. Composition calibrated for overlaid text: keep LEFT 45% softly lit cream with no objects or busy details. Bowl occupies x=48–94%, y=38–90%, fully visible with 6% right/bottom margin. A complete small black-lidded glass jar with cream Nourish Spoon label is behind the bowl at the far right, x=78–94%, y=8–62%, in soft focus. Green leaves occupy only upper right. Food is attractive, crisp and realistic; no copper/metal bowls. NO UI, headings, captions, buttons, badge, carousel, border, watermark or text outside the jar label. Do not reproduce the reference screenshot's UI. Same camera, warm cream/gold/forest palette and composition across this set. Subject: Golden traditional panjeeri with almonds, walnuts and pumpkin seeds heaped in the complete wooden bowl; matching panjeeri jar. Match the reference hero's food closely.
